meta.description: ACCEPTANCE for the authored slope (?ribrun=1, src/pure/ribrun.js): climb the whole ribline — 6 risers of 2 tiles over treads of 7, 12 tiles of ascent — with NO new input and no route knowledge. The policy is the claim: hold right, and hop on a metronome at the rib's own tread period (640ms ~= tread/runSpeed = 7/10.8), which the geometry is authored to make a fixed point — every riser then arrives at the same phase of the same jump arc. The only reactive rule is the backstop: `pinned` (grounded, commanded right, no speed) taps jump, which is what recovers the one case the three geometry repair tiers hand back to the player, a wall slide down to the deck below. No ledge markers, no dedicated key, no timed route table: the rib is the same seven tiles over and over. EXPECTED: completed/VICTORY around 4.5-5.5s, hp 3, 0 falls, 0 setbacks, y ending on the crest (15+). Measured headlessly against the same sim (tools/pathcheck.mjs drives it at 60Hz/30Hz and the 0.05s dt clamp): 4.05-4.63s, 94-97% of the pass airborne, 9.6-11.1 t/s average forward speed with every repair paid for, 7-8 jumps, air jump never spent. A run that does NOT complete, or that costs hull, is the regression signal — the rib must be climbable on run + jump alone with the frozen jump constants. Run the FLOW comparison with the same script and &flow=1 appended to the url (the operator packet's A/B).

servedFixture.source: window.HB.fixture + HB.snapshot() on the served page

jumpCounts.note: sliceStats.airJumps resets to 0 on every retry/resetGame — these reflect the current attempt only, not a session total

metrics.deathsScope: fixture retries: sliceStats.attempts increments (src/main.js resetGame, inside `if (ACTIVE_FIXTURE)`). A HULL FALLBACK absorption is not a retry — see metrics.score.setbacks — and a manual R restart increments the same counter.

lives.note: stock lives spent, from player.lives on the telemetry channel. Inside a fixture this is 0 by design — fixtures retry instead of spending a life; metrics.deaths names the counter that applies to THIS run.

route.method: greedy nearest-connector-in-order match against the SERVED build's own fixture (window.HB.fixture, id "traversal-ribrun-v1"), radius 2.2 tiles — approximate, not a topological solve. routeIds (A.5 "route coverage") lists every route with >= 3 connectors matched in order; matchedRouteId/confidence is this harness's supplementary single-best-guess summary.

darePocket.unavailableReason: the served fixture (traversal-ribrun-v1) collapses its dare pocket to a zero-width span (x0 === x1), which is how src/pure/ribrun.js switches the pocket off — there is no pocket on this build to enter

protoScore.note: proxy: airborneKills/links are approximated from kills+grounded and the route matcher, not real HB.score.events — see README
